experiment.name: rws-conflict-2352-lifetime-repeated-acceptance
experiment.description: Serial paired current-main and Boolean undo-lifetime candidate across RWS Example_2 conflictDriven, satOptimized and default routes. Three repeats, LP off, one processor, seed1, wall60s/node100k. Deadline outcomes are not equal-work cost comparisons; preserve all raw records and executed binary identities.
